## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      10 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 7, 2026 - Oct 18, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _I_Adze_, Oct 18, 2026, 1/5: "Was a loyal user of Forest for 5 years, I paid for the app and loved it for 4 of those years The app took a new direction around a year ago, it moved from a one-time fee to a freemium model and this was the beginning of the slop The app moved from incredibly stable to receiving regular forced updates that introduced bugs. The team introduced more trees along with daily login events and timed events. This completely defeats the point of getting off your phone and focusing. When your focus app needs you to log in daily and rewards you with cosmetics, it is no longer a focus app, it’s part of the problem. Under the most recent update they removed the ability to configure “favourites” which were easy to pick combinations of tags and trees, completely gutting my use of the app and violating their promise of retaining pro features that users paid for. Do not trust this company, do not download this app. It will demand your attention and focus on your screen, it will not help you focus on other things. It’s a shame as it was a great app for many years. They should’ve left the app as it was and paid for the marketing of a new app, but instead they chose to predate their own user base in lieu of taking the risk of launching a new app."
            2. _Rachel C_, Sep 27, 2026, 1/5: "I've used Forest for years as a pro member, but the recent UI updates have made it almost unusable. I've gone from using Forest every day to barely opening the app, and unless the developers listen to consumer feedback and go back to the way things were, I'll be uninstalling the app. Such a shame, a great app completely ruined!"
            3. _pay in app_, Sep 26, 2026, 1/5: "It used to be useful, fun and clean. Not it’s slow, buggy & has so many annoying options that are distracting that it completely beats the purpose. I just deleted it after years of use."
<!--/ir-theme-->
